faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do we need to buy new TVs?
faq.a1: Most likely not. Castella runs natively on Samsung, LG and Philips Smart TVs from recent years. If you have older screens, a small media player per room is an affordable bridge.
faq.a2: A single property typically goes live within one day. Rollouts across groups take one to two weeks per property, handled by our onboarding team alongside yours.
faq.q3: How does casting protect guest privacy?
faq.a3: Casting uses token-based pairing that never exposes account credentials to the TV. All pairing data and sign-ins are wiped from the room the moment a guest checks out.
faq.q4: Can we run our own content and branding?
faq.a4: Completely. Channels, menus, welcome screens and the interface itself carry your branding. Our content team can also produce and update material for you on request.

about.title: The room's most seen screen, finally seen to
about.subtitle: We are a team of hospitality technologists on a mission to fix the most neglected touchpoint of the stay.
about.story: Castella was born in 2021 in a Lisbon hotel, where two engineers watched a guest fight a TV menu for ten minutes and give up. Hotels spend millions on lobbies and bedding — then leave the room's biggest screen in the last decade. We set out to change that, one room at a time. Today Castella serves properties in 34 countries.

service.p: Castella provides a cloud-based hospitality TV platform including guest-facing applications and management tools, offered under per-property agreements. Features depend on the agreed scope.

accounts.p: Properties are responsible for the legality of distributed content in their territory, for guest data handled under their own privacy policies, and for keeping staff credentials secure.

billing.p: Subscriptions renew automatically each period until cancelled. Cancellations take effect at the end of the paid period. No long-term lock-in applies.

what.p: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. We use them to remember your language and appearance preferences and to understand aggregated traffic on our website.

which.p: sh_lang remembers your chosen interface language. sh_mode and sh_accent remember your dark/light and colour preferences. All of them are first-party, optional and expire within one year.

control.p: You can clear these cookies at any time through your browser settings. Doing so resets language and appearance preferences to their defaults without affecting site functionality.
